notes: Use when explaining why one authored beam/rafter may be split into several analysis elements or why element results must roll back to member-level provenance.
prompt: A user sees one rafter in the UI but three beam-column elements in the solver artifact. Explain what knowledge the agent should retrieve.
title: Authored Member Vs Analysis Element
unacceptable_answer_patterns: call every split analysis element a separate authored beam
lose release or load provenance across element splits
treat element force output as a final design result
